defects.description: The containment check compares the joined path with the root by prefix only, so a sibling directory that merely shares the root's name ("/srv/assets-v2" for root "/srv/assets") satisfies the check and a resolved path escapes the root the README guarantees.

trigger.expected: D1 Resolve("../assets-v2/key.pem") -> err=assets: path leaves the root

defects.why_missed: The suite rejects "../secrets/key.pem", which joins to "/srv/secrets/key.pem" and fails the prefix check; nothing exercises a sibling directory whose name extends the root's, so the check looks exercised and correct.

defects.description: Bundle joins a manifest target onto the root with no containment check at all, so a manifest entry that walks upwards returns a path outside the root, which the README promises for bundle paths exactly as for request paths.

trigger.expected: D2 Bundle("admin") with manifest admin=../../etc/passwd -> err=assets: path leaves the root
trigger.actual: D2 Bundle("admin") with manifest admin=../../etc/passwd -> path="/etc/passwd" err=<nil>

defects.why_missed: Every bundle test uses a manifest entry the build emits ("bundles/app.min.js"), so the second path that reaches the filesystem is never handed a value that leaves the root.
